'''Top 8 with Corran and Batmouse''' is a ''Star Wars'' CCG game-show podcast on the KendallCast Network, hosted by [[Kendall Halman]] (Corran) and [[Anthony Howard]] (Batmouse). In each episode the hosts and guests build a ranked list of eight cards or topics, with a trivia segment.<ref name="ia-kendall">[https://archive.org/search?query=creator%3A%22Kendall+Halman%22 Kendall Halman uploads], Internet Archive (audio items, 2019–2026).</ref> 15 episodes were released from 7 January 2023 to 13 March 2025, with audio on the Internet Archive.<ref name="t1">[https://archive.org/details/top-8-1-1-1-locations Top 8 with Corran and Batmouse - 1 - 1-1 Locations], Kendall Halman, Internet Archive (7 January 2023).</ref><ref name="t15">[https://archive.org/details/top-8-15-information-brokers Top 8 With Corran and Batmouse - 15 - Information Brokers], Kendall Halman, Internet Archive (13 March 2025).</ref> The network's master feed, CorranCast, carries it alongside [[Corran on the Horn]].<ref name="rss">[https://rssamplifier.com/corrancast CorranCast], RSS Amplifier (KendallCast Network master feed).</ref>

Guests include Players Committee advocates such as Rules Advocate [[Greg Zinn]] (episode 2) and Design Advocate [[Chris Kelly]] (episode 4).<ref name="t2">[https://archive.org/details/top-8-2-appendix-c-rules Top 8 With Corran and Batmouse - 2 - Appendix C Rules], Kendall Halman, Internet Archive (16 February 2023).</ref><ref name="t4">[https://archive.org/details/top-8-4-skywalkers Top 8 with Corran and Batmouse - 4 - Skywalkers], Kendall Halman, Internet Archive (3 May 2023).</ref>
